title: To designate the medical center of the Department of Veterans Affairs in Huntington, West Virginia, as the Hershel "Woody" Williams VA Medical Center.
official_summary: (Sec. 1) This bill designates the medical center of the Department of Veterans Affairs in Huntington, West Virginia, as the "Hershel `Woody' Williams VA Medical Center."

summary.headline: Renames the VA medical center in Huntington, West Virginia, after Medal of Honor recipient Hershel "Woody" Williams.
summary.what_it_does: This law changes the official name of the Department of Veterans Affairs medical center in Huntington, West Virginia, to the Hershel "Woody" Williams VA Medical Center. It honors Hershel Williams, a Marine who received the Medal of Honor for his service in World War II. The law does not change the center's services, staffing, or budget.
